answer: Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms, so your December 2025 offer was good for 300 additional miles or 7 days, whichever came first. Since the 7 days would have passed long ago, that offer has almost certainly expired by now. You can request a new offer at any time; the new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower, and new offers are valid for 5 days or 250 additional miles.
